import random

seed = int(input())
rng = random.Random(seed)
letters = rng.choice(["a", "ab", "abc"])
n = rng.randint(1, 14)
if rng.random() < 0.6:
    block = "".join(rng.choice(letters) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)))
    s = list((block * n)[:n])
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        s[rng.randrange(n)] = rng.choice(letters)
    s = "".join(s)
else:
    s = "".join(rng.choice(letters) for _ in range(n))
print(s)
